question: Who along with Arthur Compton received the Nobel Prize in 1927 for the development of the cloud chamber for the detection of charged particles?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Charles Wilson.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Arthur Compton** was an **American physicist** who received the** Nobel Prize **in **Physics in 1927 **along with **Charles Wilson** for his discovery of the **Compton effect.**
 
• The **cloud chamber** is a device used in particle physics to detect the **presence of charged particles. **
 
• Charles Wilson was a **Scottish physicist **who invented the **Wilson cloud chamber,** a device used to detect ionizing radiation.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Frederick Soddy** was an English chemist who worked on **radioactivity and isotopes.**

 
 
• **​**Together with **Ernest Rutherford**, he clarified that **elemental transmutation**—which is today understood to involve** nuclear reactions**—is the source of** radioactivity. **
 
 
 
• **Ernest Lawrence **was an American physicist who invented the** cyclotron,** a device used to** accelerate charged particles.**
 
 
• **​**For the invention of the cyclotron, he was awarded the **1939 Nobel Prize in Physics.**
 
 
 
• **Harold Urey** was an **American chemist** who received the** Nobel Prize in Chemistry **in** 1934 **for his discovery of** deuterium.**
